The countable product of N(0,1), with coordinate observations, satisfies the complete IID, L2 and strictly positive variance hypotheses; this is Lean-checked in scratch/Check.lean. The variance is one. No fourth moment is assumed by the statement.

The countable product of the real Bernoulli law (delta_0+delta_1)/2 has exactly the stipulated IID observations and marginal law. This full antecedent is Lean-checked in scratch/Check.lean. Both functional examples are evaluated at its genuine CDF.

Use IID Bernoulli(1/2), F its CDF, e=1_[0,1), and the Borel bridge law of h_Z(x)=Z*e(x) with Z~N(0,1/4). Every path is in cdfTangent F; its covariance is e(s)*e(t)/4, exactly the prescribed kernel, and every finite linear combination is Gaussian. Take T(f)=f(0) and L(h)=h(0). Evaluation is continuous linear, gives the required Hadamard derivative, and has measurable scalar empirical plug-ins. L(h_Z)=Z is L2 with variance 1/4>0.
